setting.help: Email each user who opted in a morning summary of the activities they must deal with. Users with nothing due are not emailed.

div.div: Each user switches the digest on for themselves under Preferences > Activity Digest. The sending time lives in Settings > Technical > Scheduled Actions ("Send daily activity digest emails").

button.name: action_activity_digest_enable_all
button.string: Turn on for all internal users
button.confirm: Every active internal user will start receiving the daily digest. They can switch it off again in their own preferences. Continue?
